description: This Non-Conventional Institute Core (audit) course, offered by the Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, makes students acquainted with the journey of Sanskrit literature and helps them develop a comprehensive idea about Sanskrit language, literature, and philosophy. It is qualifying in nature (Internal: 50 Marks, Total: 50 Marks).

syllabus.title: शब्द स्वरूप एवं भेद
syllabus.body: उच्चारण-स्थान एवं प्रयत्न; पद संरचना - (क) पदस्वरूप, भेद एवं प्रयोग, (ख) सुबन्तपद, (ग) तिङन्तपद।

syllabus.title: वाक्य संरचना
syllabus.body: (क) वाक्य स्वरूप भेद एवं प्रयोग, (ख) कर्तृवाच्य, (ग) कर्मवाच्य, (घ) भाववाच्य।

syllabus.title: कारक परिचय
syllabus.body: (क) कारक स्वरूप, भेद एवं प्रयोग, (ख) विभक्तियों का अर्थ।

syllabus.title: सन्धि एवं शब्द बोध
syllabus.body: सन्धि परिचय - सन्धि स्वरूप, भेद एवं प्रयोग; शब्द बोध-प्रक्रिया एवं कारण; संस्कृत सम्भाषण।

outcomes: Attain greater understanding of different areas of Sanskrit Language and Literature.
Understand issues pertaining to origin and evolution of Sanskrit Language.
textbooks: Sanskrit Chayanika, Published by KU, Kurukshetra
